buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 2 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 3. Generic Shelf Life: The Product/Spare parts to be supplied as part of the services must have minimum 2 Shelf Life. On the date of supply, minimum 2 usable shelf life should be available / balance. 4. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 5. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s

Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses . 1. BIDDERS TO COMPLY ALL THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS ALONG WITH THE TECHNICAL SPECIFI CATIONS AS UPLOADED IN BID ATC. 2. BIDDERS ARE TO QUOTE RATE FOR OEM PRODUCTS ONLY AND SUPPLIES WILL BE ACCEPTED I N OEM ORIGINAL SEALED PACKING ONLY. 3. FOR ANY QUERY OR SAMPLE L-1 FIRM CAN MAY VISIT THE BUYER OFFICE BEFORE SUPPLY OF ITEM AFTE R RECEIPT OF CONTRACT. 4. Scope of Supply The supplier shall supply hygiene chemicals strictly as per the specifications, quantiti es, packaging sizes 5. Quality of Materials All products must be of standard commercial/industrial quality and suitable for the intended applicat ion. Products must conform to the technical specifications prescribed in the bid. Materials supplied must be genuine, unused, fresh and free from defects. The quality and concentration of chemicals must be consistent with the manufacturer's declared sp ecifications. No dilution, adulteration or unauthorized substitution shall be permitted. 6. Technical Specifications The supplier shall provide products meeting the required specifications, incl uding applicable parameters such as: Chemical composition and concentration. pH value, wherever applicable. Cleaning and disinfecting effectiveness, wherever specified. 7. Packaging and Labelling All chemicals must be supplied in original, sealed and leak-proof containers. Each container must bear the manufacturer's name, product name, batch number, manufacturing d ate, expiry date, net quantity and applicable statutory declarations. Proper usage instructions and safety precautions must be printed on the packaging. Damaged, leaking, tampered or improperly labelled containers shall not be accepted. 8. Shelf Life Products must have adequate remaining shelf life at the time of delivery. Expired products or products nearing expiry shall be liable for rejection. 9. Inspection and Acceptance All supplies shall be subject to inspection and verification by the authorized representative of the bu yer. The buyer reserves the right to verify quantity, packaging, quality, specifications, batch details and supporting documents. The buyer may reject any material found inferior, defective, damaged, expired or not conforming to the bid specifications. Acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory inspection and verification. 10. Replacement of Rejected Materials Any rejected, damaged, defective, leaking, short-supplied or non-conforming material shall be repla ced by the supplier at no additional cost. Replacement shall be completed within 7 days of notification by the buyer or within such other perio d as mutually permitted under the contract. All expenses relating to return, transportation and replacement shall be borne by the supplier.

11. Risk and Responsibility The supplier shall remain responsible for safe transportation, proper packag ing and delivery of materials until delivery at the designated consignee location. 12. After award of contract bidder shall have to get advance sample of all products approved from buyer before bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. . 9. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 11. Generic For hazardous chemical/item, all precautionary measure as per regulation from the point of transportation/ handling/ storage/ safety/ health/ environment to be undertaken/ specified before dispatch. During dispatch, proper symbol for the hazard/ MSDS/ Batch No./ date of manufacturing/ Gross Weight/ Net Weight/ shelf Life etc are to be written/ printed/ pasted on the body of the packing. 12. Sample Clause After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get advance sample approved from buyer before bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. Successful Bidder shall submit 1 samples for Buyer's approval, within 5 days of award of contract. Buyer shall, as per contract specifications framework, either approve the advance sample or will provide complete list of modification required in the sample within 5 days of receipt of advance sample. Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved sample with modifications as communicated by Buyer. If there is delay from buyer side in approval of advance sample – the delivery period shall be refixed without LD for the period of delay in sample approval. In case, the sample is found to have major deviations / not conforming to the Contract specifications, the buyer at its discretion may call for fresh samples for approval before allowing bulk supplies or may terminate the contract after notifying the deviations to the seller. Unless otherwise provided in the contract, all samples required for test shall be supplied by the contractor free of cost. Where under the contract, the contractor is required to submit an advance sample, any expenses incurred by the contractor on or in connection with the production of stores in bulk, before the sample has been approved unconditionally shall be borne by the Seller and he shall not claim any compensation in the event of such sample being found unacceptable by the Buyer / Consignee.
